title: Frontend foundation: Next.js 14 scaffold, design tokens, app shell, mock data
description:
Set up the Next.js 14 frontend skeleton at apps/web/ that all screen implementations will build on. Port the Kabanchik design system from the prototype bundle.

Source bundle: /tmp/design-extract/kabanchik-agent/project/

Scope:
- Next.js 14 App Router + TypeScript + npm
- Port design tokens from kabanchik.css (CSS vars: brand-*, ink-*, bg-*, line, danger/warn/ok/draft, density vars, dark mode)
- Density modes (compact/cozy/comfortable) via body class
- Light/dark theme via body class
- Shared UI primitives (Icon registry, Avatar, AvatarStack, StatusPill, Card, Button, Badge, Modal) — port from kabanchik-ui.jsx
- App shell: LiveBar (animated ticker), Sidebar (logo, project switcher, nav, user chip), main layout — port from kabanchik-app.jsx
- Mock data module: PROJECTS, PARTICIPANTS, MEETINGS, UPDATES, TRACE_RUNS — port from kabanchik-data.jsx, typed with TypeScript
- Routing: /, /chat, /meetings, /meetings/[id], /updates, /trace, /projects, /settings, /login
- Stub each route page with placeholder so screen agents can fill them in

Deliverable: a runnable Next.js app at apps/web/ where the shell renders, navigation works between empty placeholder routes, and tokens/density/theme switching is wired up.

title: UI tests: Playwright setup + tests for all screens
description: Per-screen Playwright UI tests at apps/web/tests/e2e/. First agent seeds Playwright config; subsequent agents add per-screen test files.

title: Address remaining frontend review feedback
description:
Code review on parallel screen implementations surfaced these items, deferred from the initial fix-pass. Group by severity.

P2 (Important):
- Home: MeetingRowCompact / UpdateRowCompact use <div onClick> instead of <button> — keyboard a11y. Files: apps/web/components/screens/home/{MeetingRowCompact,UpdateRowCompact}.tsx
- Home: Hardcoded 'MAR' month in MeetingRowCompact — derive from meeting.date instead. apps/web/components/screens/home/MeetingRowCompact.tsx:24
- Login: <a> tags for Terms/Privacy without href; missing <main> landmark. apps/web/app/login/page.tsx
- Updates: editor stale draft bug when current selection changes via filter recompute. Add useEffect reset on current?.id change. apps/web/components/screens/updates/UpdatesScreen.tsx
- Updates: Reasoning label drift ('Reasoning' should be 'Agent reasoning'); Approved drops 'Apply now' CTA; Applied drops 'Open in {target}' link. apps/web/components/screens/updates/UpdateDetail.tsx
- Projects: toast at /projects?created=1 never auto-dismisses. apps/web/app/(shell)/projects/page.tsx
- Projects: StepInvite array-index keys (reconciliation bug on row removal). apps/web/components/screens/projects/StepInvite.tsx:52
- Projects: Jira default 'PLAT' leaks into formData; should be placeholder only. apps/web/components/screens/projects/types.ts:43
- Projects: StepGoogle 'Test connection' silently disconnects. apps/web/components/screens/projects/StepGoogle.tsx:58-64
- Projects: ProjectCard wraps in Link with href='#' (dead link). apps/web/components/screens/projects/ProjectCard.tsx
- Settings: Sparkline/UsageByModel rebuilds polylines on every render. Memoize. apps/web/components/screens/settings/Sparkline.tsx, UsageByModel.tsx
- Settings: SettingsScreen switch is non-exhaustive at type level. Add never-default. apps/web/components/screens/settings/SettingsScreen.tsx
- Settings: ApiKeysTable reveal renders 'live-secret-redacted' — replace with proper masked plaintext or '[hidden in mock]'. apps/web/components/screens/settings/ApiKeysTable.tsx:42
- Settings: MembersSection roleBadge has dead Viewer branch; collapse to ternary. apps/web/components/screens/settings/MembersSection.tsx:24-28
- CSS dedup: badge-warn, .tabs/.tab/.tab-count, .link-btn defined in multiple screen CSS files. Consolidate into base.css. apps/web/styles/screens/{updates,settings,meetings}.css

P3 (Suggestions):
- Trace: Filter button + date range select are dead UI (non-functional). Wire or label as TODO. apps/web/components/screens/trace/TraceScreen.tsx:43-59
- Chat: icon-only composer buttons missing aria-label. apps/web/components/screens/chat/ChatScreen.tsx:313
- Meetings: TranscriptTab findSpeaker uses startsWith — could collide on shared first names. Use exact word boundary.
- Meetings: hardcoded 'project: platform' in subtitle.
- Meetings: Next 15 params is Promise — verify Next 14 is pinned (it is) before upgrading.
- Misc: many array-index React keys — replace with stable ids when types get them.
